section_summary.extract_value: This abstract reports a single cross-sectional study of 326 middle-aged Saudi women recruited from primary health centers in Hofuf city, examining body appreciation (BA), BMI, and weight-loss (WL) efforts. Mean age was 49.14 years and mean BMI 29.64 kg/m2; 78.5% had attempted weight loss and BA fully mediated the relationship between BMI and WL. The abstract does not report the specific BA instrument (BAS/BAS-2), whether BMI was measured or self-reported, racial/ethnic composition, or numeric correlation coefficients.
